pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, double-blind, double-dummy, parallel-group, active-controlled, multicenter outcomes trial with sequential single-blind enalapril and LCZ696 run-in periods
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Time to first occurrence of composite of cardiovascular death or heart failure hospitalization
pivotal_trials.result: Primary composite endpoint: HR 0.80 (95% CI 0.73–0.87), 1-sided p=0.0000002; CV death: HR 0.80 (95% CI 0.71–0.89); HF hospitalization: HR 0.79 (95% CI 0.71–0.89); all-cause mortality: HR 0.84 (95% CI 0.76–0.93), 1-sided p=0.0005

boxed_warning.content: Embryo-fetal toxicity (can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman; discontinue as soon as possible when pregnancy is detected)
boxed_warning.full_text:
WARNING: FETAL TOXICITY
- When pregnancy is detected, discontinue ENTRESTO as soon as possible.
- Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus.

key_safety: In PARADIGM-HF, LCZ696 was associated with higher rates of hypotension (24.4% vs. 18.6%) and angioedema (0.45% vs. 0.24% confirmed cases in the double-blind period, with 2.35% vs. 0.47% in Black patients), while rates of renal impairment (16.2% vs. 17.6%) and hyperkalemia (11.9% vs. 14.3%) were lower compared to enalapril.
target_moa: Dual inhibition of neprilysin (sacubitril, a neprilysin inhibitor prodrug) and the angiotensin II type 1 receptor (valsartan, an ARB), leading to enhanced natriuretic peptide activity and reduced angiotensin II-mediated vasoconstriction and aldosterone release

_meta.indication:
ENTRESTO is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (NYHA Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.
ENTRESTO is usually administered in conjunction with other heart failure therapies, in place of an ACE inhibitor or other ARB.

indication_details.population_restrictions: chronic heart failure NYHA Class II-IV with reduced ejection fraction
indication_details.combination: in combination with other heart failure therapies (unspecified); replaces ACE inhibitor or other ARB

supplements.description: Expanded indication to include **pediatric patients aged one year and older** with "symptomatic heart failure with systemic left ventricular systolic dysfunction," supported by pediatric data in children ages 1 to <18 years with dilated cardiomyopathy (DCM).

Expanded the Indications and Usage labeling for Entresto (sacubitril/valsartan) to incorporate data from the PARAGON-HF trial, reflecting updated language for patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, with substantive revisions to the Clinical Studies section as well.

Expanded the approved indication for Entresto (sacubitril/valsartan) tablets and added a new oral pellet formulation (Entresto Sprinkle) for "the treatment of symptomatic heart failure with systemic left ventricular systolic dysfunction in pediatric patients aged one year and older."
